reported_manifests.interpretation: Different runtime/precision policies are a joint treatment; manifests are not independently verified operator dispatch.

published_sample_summary.interpretation: Arithmetic over public author sample arrays; not a fresh device measurement or action-response/control-frequency result.

memory.interpretation: Periodic whole-device samples on an author-described isolated GPU; not process-attributed or one sample per request.

quality.evidence: Author aggregate and task tables; raw episode artifacts absent from the pinned tree
quality.interpretation: Retain per-task loss. Aggregate closeness and overlapping Wilson intervals do not establish equivalence or noninferiority.

reported_exclusion.scope: Historical closed-loop Python timing diagnostics, not the fixed-boundary arrays
reported_exclusion.handling: Exact-index exclusion described with raw sample retained and filtered/unfiltered summaries; no quality or memory sample removed

source_version_boundaries.closed_loop_tree_state: Uncommitted changes; full source patch not supplied
source_version_boundaries.interpretation: Neither public script hash matches the measured-script hash; binary identity or dirty-path count does not identify the missing source patch.

exclusions_and_limits: Selected file regions support benchmark methodology, not whole-repository or WAM/runtime-support qualification.
Fixed fixtures, raw episode logs, complete measurement patch, weights and datasets are absent or excluded; no replacement data is invented.
Broader native kernels, model math, quantizer correctness and effective dtype dispatch are outside this qualification.
Source code, published sample arithmetic and author quality reports remain distinct from model/device/service and agent-efficacy validation.
Source numeric protocol values are contextual, not InferRSI default thresholds.
